prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE independent reusable game UI surface sprite, a blank cream knitted rounded rectangular card / button frame, for Flutter nine-slice scaling.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: Pourlune original P04 tutorial and P06 pause cream knit cards and cream buttons. Do not reproduce the screenshot or any screen composition.
Primary request: generate a single isolated wide cream knitted rounded rectangle, front orthographic view, on a genuinely transparent background. Shape aspect ratio approximately 2.6:1, with softly rounded rectangle corners (not a capsule) and a substantial but restrained soft 3D cream rim. Fine chunky yarn knit V-stitches, closely matching the soft ivory wool material and subtle peach-beige shading of the reference cream pause card. The entire center is filled with fine LOW-CONTRAST cream knitting suitable for overlaying real dark text. Center must stay calm and evenly lit. A slight raised puffy edge and subtle lower-edge shading gives tactile dimension. Soft light from upper left, consistent frontal UI lighting, no perspective tilt.
Composition: one object only, large and centered, nearly fills a landscape canvas edge to edge with only a thin transparent safety margin. Target canvas approximately 2048 by 896 or similarly high-resolution landscape. Preserve complete outer edge and soft contact shading, all outside pixels truly transparent. Enough resolution for a large dialog card and reusable control frames. Edge texture should be regular enough for nine-slice scaling, clean straight central edge spans.
Constraints: NO letters, NO numerals, NO symbols, NO icons, NO logo, NO watermark, NO additional objects, NO full UI page, NO border scene, NO hands, NO colored backdrop, NO checkerboard baked into pixels. NO hole in the center. Do not create a separate decorative outer border. Do not create a square canvas with a tiny object. Only the blank cream knitted rounded rectangle sprite.
Targeted clean-edge refinement: The transparent margin must contain absolutely no scattered cotton wisps, white flecks, dust, halo debris or separated pixels. A tightly knitted clean continuous silhouette with minimal yarn fuzz. Give the complete object 3% clear transparent safety margin on every side. Use finer smaller stitches like the original card (about 70 columns across), not large chunky blanket stitches. The rim is soft and thin, not a thick rope frame. Keep the original low-contrast soft ivory material, front view, blank filled center, wide rounded rectangle. Single independent sprite only.

references.role: Style reference only: P04/P06 cream knit cards and control surfaces

pixel_modifications: NONE. Selected generated PNG copied byte-identically. Pillow used for inspection only.
selection: Second generation selected for finer lower-contrast stitches and thinner rim. First unselected generation remains in tool default output folder.
verification_scope: Asset inspection, alpha geometry, hashes and byte-identical copies only. No Flutter runtime, build, visual acceptance or rights acceptance performed.

recommended_centerSlice.coordinate_space: raw PNG pixel coordinates (for full raw bitmap Image.centerSlice)
recommended_centerSlice.reason: Preserves rounded corners and rim; stretches calm interior and straight edge spans.
recommended_centerSlice.raw_margin_caution: Alpha>0 wisps at canvas edges; meaningful alpha>=32 body bbox is (39,99,1860,730). Native crop/mapping must be evaluated by integration owner; no cropping applied here.
recommended_centerSlice.visual_caution: Nine-slice stretches center stitch dimensions, so inspect large dialog vs short controls separately.

visual_inspection.appearance: Blank cream ivory rounded rectangle; fine low-contrast repeated V knitting; slightly peach-beige puffed rim and gentle lower shadow; no text/icons/numerals; frontal orthographic view.
visual_inspection.alpha_caveat: Very low-alpha fringe/wisps remain outside meaningful silhouette in raw generation. All four corner alpha values are zero. Preserved unchanged per raw-output requirement.
